text:
maya: Quick check — finalizing the RFC review slots for Thu 3:00pm PT. Authors: @rahul (model-routing RFC), @ellie (prefix-caching RFC), @tom (gradual-rollout RFC). Can everyone confirm availability? Also proposing ordering: caching -> routing -> rollout (shortest first).

rahul: I can make Thu 3pm but would prefer to go 2nd if possible. My pre-read is in PR #421 (docs/routing). Can folks skim by Wed EOD?

ellie: confirmed, happy to go first. I'll drop slides + TL;DR in the doc by Wed 10am.

tom: I _might_ be on pager Thurs afternoon. If I can't present live, @zach can do the walkthrough. Otherwise I can present but may need to cut ~5 mins.

maya: ok — plan: ellie -> rahul -> tom, with zach as fallback for tom. Pre-reads due Wed 5pm so reviewers have time. Agenda timing: 12m present / 8m Q each. I'll update the agenda and calendar.

zach: happy to backfill for tom. pls add me to the pre-read doc and ping if you want me to rehearse.

ellie: pre-read link: https://rwd.internal/docs/rfcs/prefix-caching (will add slides, TL;DR at top). Small note: I have one demo, will keep it short.

rahul: :thumbsup: I'll review ellie's doc Wed morning. Also can we add a short 'open questions' slot at the end for cross-RFC dependency discussion? 5 min. We had some cross-deps last time.

maya: good call. Adding 5m cross-dep/Q at the end. Final agenda block (will paste into calendar invite):
```
1) Prefix caching (ellie) — 12m + 8m Q
2) Model routing (rahul) — 12m + 8m Q
3) Gradual rollout (tom) — 12m + 8m Q (fallback: zach)
4) Cross-RFC dependencies / next steps — 5m
```

rahul: can we also cap slides to 6? helps keep things tight.

maya: yes — 6 slides cap. I'll add that to the invite and set a hard end time.

agenda-bot: Event updated: "RFC Review — Thu 2026-03-19 15:00 PT" — description and agenda updated.

maya: TODOs: 1) authors upload pre-reads by Wed 17:00 PT, 2) reviewers add comments + mark "pre-read done" reaction, 3) zach is backup for tom. Ping me if anything changes.

tom: thanks — will try to present but will flag by Wed EOD if I need zach to cover.

ellie: done — slides uploaded, TL;DR at top. link in thread.

rahul: reviewed ellie's doc, left 3 comments. planning to finish routing slides Wed afternoon.

maya: perfect — looks like we're set. I'll post the final invite note and lock the agenda at Wed 18:00 PT. Please try to respect the timing so we don't spill into engineers' afternoons. :calendar:
